headline: EPS rises both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Brigade Enterprises reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₹5.14, up 15.2% q/q from ₹4.46 and up 11.8% y/y from ₹4.60.
summary_long: EPS of ₹5.14 rose 15.2% sequentially from ₹4.46 and 11.8% year-over-year from ₹4.60. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
